title: Art. 3.31 — Annex 9 - Facilitation, Chapter 3 - Entry and Departure of Persons and Their Baggage, H. Inspection of travel documents, 3.31
content: Contracting States shall assist aircraft operators in the evaluation of travel documents presented by passengers, in order to deter fraud and abuse.
